AlumniJourney.title: Alumni Journey Submission
AlumniJourney.description: Public career, college, stream, and current pursuit record submitted by a Shalom Hills International School alumnus for display in the Alumni Directory.

alumniId.description: Linked ID from the verified registered alumni list (e.g., alm-12) or 'community' for new alumni.

professionOrRole.description: Current job title, profession, degree program, or role.

collegeOrOrganization.description: Current college, university, company, or organization.

streamOrField.description: Academic stream, major, or industry domain (e.g., Computer Science, Medicine, Commerce, Law).

whatImDoing.description: Open description of what the alumnus is currently working on, studying, or pursuing.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the alumnus who submitted this entry.

authorDisplayName.description: Display name of the authenticated submitter.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/alumni_journeys/{journeyId}.description: Stores alumni career, college, stream, and current pursuit submissions displayed on the Alumni Directory.
